edits.headline: Musk unveils new Tesla Roadster he says is a flying car
edits.subheadline: The car was unveiled at a SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas, DT Next reported.
editorialBody: Elon Musk unveiled a new Tesla Roadster that he says is a flying car, ABC News reported. The car was shown at a SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas, DT Next reported.

In India, the Enforcement Directorate detained Punjabi film producer Amardeep Singh Grewal at Delhi airport, UNI reported. Outlook India reported that the ED had summoned Grewal, the Punjab chief minister's brother-in-law, in an alleged bribery case.

In Delhi, protests continued after police detained Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and others during the party's Tiranga march, the Kathmandu Post reported. A video from the march that allegedly showed a woman slapping a CRPF officer is under investigation by Delhi Police, The Week reported.
